what.text: This page follows refugees from Algeria living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3728 Algerian refugees in France, 40.6% of all refugees from Algeria.
France is the largest host of Algerian refugees, followed by Canada, Germany and Portugal.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Algeria in every year from 1991 to 2018 and in 2020, with the GIA and AQIM among the opponents.
The main year of displacement in the data, 1994, falls within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at its highest figure, 20000 refugees.
It fell to a low in 1995 and has risen since.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
